title: 第17章 州会来暗流涌动第18章 剑体成异象轰动
content_zh:
天雷峰。
突然来了一位不速之客，从天而降，如羽毛一般浮落在天雷峰的洞府门前，无声无息，身法了得。
身为丹脉长老、天雷峰之主的祝天虹很快感觉到，连忙出来迎接。
“副门主大驾光临，天雷峰蓬荜生辉！”祝天虹恭敬笑道，心中却是七上八下，在无极门，众所周知，副门主登门拜访必不是好事。
来的自然是无极门副门主厉秋雨，旁边还有跟随而来的执法长老闻松。
厉秋雨蒙着面纱，气质冷傲，淡声说道：
“祝长老，这些漂亮话就不用说了，此次前来事关无极门要事，你那徒儿林玄可在？”
此话一出，祝天虹心里咯噔一声，他害怕的就是林玄，讪笑说道：“这......真不巧，如今他不在天雷峰。”
厉秋雨闻言，气质又冷了几分，连带着周围的空气都冷了几分。
旁边的闻松见状，冷哼说道：
“祝长老，您这徒儿可真难请啊，上次副门主邀请前去，他拒绝了，如今副门主亲自登门，人却不在天雷峰。”
对于林玄曾被谢清影邀请一事，闻松自然是知晓的，毕竟若非如此，他当时也不可能安然无恙放林玄离开。
祝天虹听到此话，脸色也不是不好，连忙陪笑道：
“副门主恕罪，我这徒儿本就是半路收的，这些年他都呆在天雷峰寸步不离，对于门内规矩一概不懂......这小子，居然敢如此怠慢，副门主放心！等他回来，老夫必定带他前去请罪。”
虽然祝天虹沉迷炼丹，但是说话方面也是非常圆滑，但这一番话下来，厉秋雨脸色却没有丝毫缓和，很明显，林玄惹得厉秋雨不悦了。
“不知，刚刚副门主找我那徒儿，是为何事？”祝天虹心中微微苦笑，询问道。
厉秋雨淡声说道：“祝长老可记得半月后的三十六州会？”
听闻此话，祝天虹心中顿时了然，点头道：“当然！三十六州会，乃三十六州天骄弟子汇聚论道之盛事，乃天炎国主办，五年一次，决定着南域各大门派的兴衰气运。”
“难道是为三十六州会人选一事？这，小徒居然能被副门主看重去参加三十六州会，这是好事，也是机缘啊！想当年，老夫也曾去过一次论道丹术，只不过寂寂无闻。”
说着，祝天虹叹息了一声。

厉秋雨点头，然后说道：“此行便是为了此事，无极门发展青黄不接，除了谢清影之外，年轻一辈能拿得出手的并无一人，门主也是颇为忧愁。”
“可是副门主，我那徒儿修为才灵武而已，这境界差距是否有些太大了？”
祝天虹皱眉说道，不知道厉秋雨葫芦里卖的什么药。
“是否能够去，总是要试试，三日后，让他与谢清影比试一场，若赢了当之无愧无极门年轻一代第一人！但若输了......”
厉秋雨淡声说着，紧接着话锋一转，道：
“若是输了，那就进入镇狱之地，历练几年。”
content_en:
Tianleifeng.
Suddenly, an uninvited guest came, falling from the sky, floating like a feather in front of the cave door of Tianlei Peak, silently and with great movement skills.
Zhu Tianhong, as the Danmai Elder and the Lord of Tianlei Peak, quickly sensed this and hurriedly came out to greet him.
"The deputy sect master is here to make Tianlei Peak shine!" Zhu Tianhong smiled respectfully, but he was in a state of confusion. In Wuji Sect, as we all know, it is not a good thing for the deputy sect master to visit us.
Naturally, the one who came was Li Qiuyu, deputy sect leader of Wuji Sect, and law enforcement elder Wen Song followed.
Li Qiuyu was veiled, with a cold and arrogant temperament, and said quietly:
"Elder Zhu, there is no need to say these beautiful words. This visit involves important matters of Wuji Sect. Is your disciple Lin Xuan here?"
As soon as these words came out, Zhu Tianhong's heart skipped a beat. He was afraid of Lin Xuan. He said with a smile: "This... what a coincidence. Now he is not at Tianlei Peak."
Hearing this, Li Qiuyu's temperament became a little colder, and even the surrounding air became a little colder.
When Wen Song next to him saw this, he snorted and said:
"Elder Zhu, it's really hard to recruit a disciple like yours. Last time, the deputy sect leader invited him to come, but he refused. Now, the deputy sect leader is here in person, but he is not at Tianlei Peak."
Wen Song naturally knew that Lin Xuan had been invited by Xie Qingying. After all, if not for this, he would not have let Lin Xuan leave unharmed.
When Zhu Tianhong heard this, his expression was not bad, and he quickly smiled and said:
"Deputy Sect Master, please forgive me. I took this disciple in halfway. He has stayed at Tianlei Peak for these years and knows nothing about the rules in the sect... This kid actually dares to be so negligent. Deputy Sect Master, don't worry! When he comes back, I will definitely take him to apologize."
Although Zhu Tianhong was obsessed with alchemy and was very tactful in his speech, Li Qiuyu's expression did not soften at all after these words. It was obvious that Lin Xuan had made Li Qiuyu unhappy.
"I don't know, why did the deputy sect master look for my disciple just now?" Zhu Tianhong asked with a wry smile in his heart.
Li Qiuyu said quietly: "Elder Zhu, do you remember the Thirty-Six States Meeting half a month later?"
Hearing this, Zhu Tianhong suddenly understood and nodded: "Of course! The Thirty-Six States Conference is a grand event where the disciples of the thirty-six states gather to discuss Taoism. It is hosted by Tianyan Kingdom and happens once every five years. It determines the rise and fall of the major sects in the Southern Region."
"Could it be a matter of selecting candidates for the Thirty-Six States Conference? This young disciple is actually recognized by the deputy sect leader to participate in the Thirty-six States Conference. This is a good thing and an opportunity! I think that back then, I also went to discuss Taoism and Alchemy once, but it was unknown."
With that said, Zhu Tianhong sighed.
Li Qiuyu nodded, and then said: "This trip is for this matter. Wuji Sect's development is slow and slow. Except for Xie Qingying, there is no one in the younger generation who can do anything. The sect leader is also quite worried."
"But deputy sect leader, my disciple is just a martial artist. Is the gap in realm too big?"
Zhu Tianhong frowned and said, wondering what kind of medicine Li Qiuyu sold in the gourd.
"Whether he can go, he has to give it a try. Three days later, let him compete with Xie Qingying. If he wins, he will be the number one of the younger generation of Wuji Sect! But if he loses..."
Li Qiuyu said quietly, then changed the topic and said:
"If you lose, then you will enter the prison and practice for a few years."
